newsitem.title: USA: Compositech expands production, signs deals.
newsitem.headline: Compositech expands production, signs deals.

text.p: Compositech Ltd said Wednesday it had expanded its production of its patented laminates for printed wiring boards using recently installed equipment with proceeds from its public offering.

The company also said it signed marketing and sales distribution agreements with two manfacturers' representatives to provide sales and service coverage for the Southeast and Middle Atlantic regions of the U.S.

Candor Co Inc of Myrtle Beach, S.C. will be representing Compositech in Virginia and the Carolinas, while Omni Circuit Supply Inc of Melbourne, Fla. will handle accounts in Alabama, Georgia and Florida.
The company said it now has the added production capacity at its Hauppauge plant to support rapid sales growth.
Compositech makes and sells laminates used to make printed circuit boards, which are components of personal computers, telecommunications equipment, automobiles and other electronic equipment.
